guest_ack_state.interpretation: The initial semaphore is empty and no stale ACK pointer exists before the timeout. The failure begins with delayed delivery, not a spurious semaphore release.

late_event_order.event: late Reset Complete delivered to HLI
Bumble returns the new command response
NimBLE schedules reset for process-ack error

failure_chain: HCI Reset response reached QEMU but HLI delivery was delayed for 4.506306 seconds of host trace time.
The guest timed out and issued more HCI Reset commands while older Reset Complete packets were still pending.
HLI recovery released the older Reset Complete packets after the guest had advanced to another command.
NimBLE matched a late Reset Complete with the wrong command and scheduled reset with ble_hs_hci_process_ack error 12.
The reset path later reached LoadProhibited at ble_hs_hci_process_ack, symbol 0x402630cc.
The final PC=0 trap is secondary to the reset loop.
